import bpy,numpy as np,math,struct,zlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
W,H=512,1024
v,u=np.mgrid[0:H,0:W].astype(np.float32)/np.array([H-1,W-1],np.float32)[:,None,None]
center=.51+.045*np.sin(v*math.tau*1.3)+.018*np.sin(v*math.tau*3.8)
width=.36+.035*np.sin(v*math.tau*2.1+.6)
def smooth(a,b,x):
 t=np.clip((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)
alpha=smooth(0,.18,width-np.abs(u-center))*smooth(.025,.16,v)*(1-smooth(.80,.975,v))
alpha*=.57+.10*np.sin(u*17+v*11)*np.sin(v*23-u*7)
rgba=np.ones((H,W,4),np.float32)
rgba[:,:,:3]=np.array([.617,.583,.475])+(np.sin(u*11+v*9)*np.sin(v*17-u*4))[:,:,None]*.007
rgba[:,:,3]=alpha
a=np.round(np.clip(rgba,0,1)*255).astype(np.uint8)[::-1]
def chunk(k,d):return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+k+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(k+d)&0xffffffff)
b=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',W,H,8,6,0,0,0))
b+=chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(b''.join(b'\x00'+r.tobytes() for r in a),6))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')

n=p.inputs['Base Color'].links[0].from_node;n.image=im;nt.links.new(n.outputs['Alpha'],p.inputs['Alpha'])
m.surface_render_method='BLENDED'
if hasattr(m,'use_transparency_overlap'):m.use_transparency_overlap=False
for name in ['SP13 compacted shore access','ShipyardCOMBINED_SP13_CompactedAccess']:
 o=bpy.data.objects[name];uv=o.data.uv_layers.active
